About.title: ABOUT ME
About.bio1: I'm {name}, a software engineer focused on building robust systems: from desktop apps with AES-256-GCM encryption to algorithmic trading bots and supply chain security tools in Go.
About.bio2: I work primarily with TypeScript (Next.js / Electron), Python (FastAPI) and Go. I'm interested in hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, and automation with AI agents.
About.bio3: I operate from Colombia for the world. Every project is a real engineering problem, not a portfolio exercise.
